scientific_integrity: Gaussian conditioning and a fourth-order Wick calculation yield an exact polynomial identity. The global sharp constant follows from the correlation elliptope Schur-complement constraint and two elementary sharp inequalities; equality matrices are classified. Reproducible rational/numerical checks only replay the algebra, not certify the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact signed criterion and globally optimal additive blockwise deviation are restricted to centered Gaussian three-vectors with one negative fractional power in (0,1) and two quadratic positive factors. The covariance may be singular. Broader exponent patterns and non-Gaussian distributions are not covered; an equivalent optimization under different terminology is a bibliographic possibility.
title: Sharp blockwise opposite Gaussian product deficit with two quadratic factors
